proposals.after: He later died after being implicated in a case.
proposals.reason: 坐累 means to be implicated/entangled in a case and suffer the consequences, not death from overwork.

proposals.before: Later, on a charge of overwork he died.
proposals.after: Later he died after being implicated in a case.
proposals.reason: 坐累 refers to implication in an offense/case, not overwork; the literal rendering invents a false charge type.

proposals.before: He was ordered to be seized by Zhou Yuan, chiliarch of the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
proposals.after: Zhou Yuan, a chiliarch of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, was ordered to go arrest them.
proposals.reason: 命…周原往捕之 means Zhou Yuan was ordered to go make the arrests; the literal wrongly makes the accused the grammatical subject of the order.

proposals.before: Yongzhou Prefect Yu Yancheng, Qidong Magistrate Zheng Min, and ten others were imprisoned on charges; the people of their districts listed their administrative achievements in petition, and all were restored to office.
proposals.after: Yongzhou Prefect Yu Yancheng, Qidong Magistrate Zheng Min, and others—ten men in all—were imprisoned on charges; the people of their districts listed their administrative achievements in petition, and all were restored to office.
proposals.reason: 等十人 means ten persons including the named officials, not “ten others” in addition to Yu and Zheng.

proposals.before: Yichun Magistrate Shen Chang and four others were further promoted to prefects.
proposals.after: Yichun Magistrate Shen Chang and three others were further promoted to prefects.
proposals.reason: 等四人 means four persons in total including Shen Chang, not Shen plus four others.

s0266 後坐累死 uses 坐累 for implication/entanglement in a case with fatal consequence; 'died from overwork' invents a false cause. The proposed idiomatic correctly renders implication leading to death.
The literal's 'charge of overwork' misreads 坐累 as a labor-related offense; 坐累 is implication in a case. The proposed literal correctly states death after implication.
s0290 命錦衣衛千戶周原往捕之 orders Zhou Yuan to go arrest them (之); the before text wrongly makes the accused the patient of 命. The proposed literal restores Zhou Yuan as the officer ordered to arrest.
